bugs.title: escalate tool fires but bot response contradicts it
bugs.description: The escalate tool was the last tool called (final_state.latest_tool_call_name='escalate'), but in every turn the bot responded with a refusal message ('No puedo completar la escalada'). Likely causes: (1) escalate tool is throwing an exception internally and the bot is catching it and softening, or (2) the tool returns a failure payload that the bot interprets as 'can't escalate'.
